title: Accounting: Credit note
description:
## Overview

Think of a credit note as a voucher issued to a customer. It is a reduction that can be applied against one or multiple invoices. A credit note can either reduce the amount owed or cancel out an invoice entirely.

In the Codat system a credit note is issued to a [customer's](https://docs.codat.io/lending-api#/schemas/Customer) accounts receivable. 

It contains details of:
* The amount of credit remaining and its status.
* Payment allocations against the payments type, in this case an invoice.
* Which customers the credit notes have been issued to.

id.description: Identifier for the credit note, unique to the company in the accounting software.

creditNoteNumber.description: Friendly reference for the credit note.

customerRef.description: Reference to the customer the credit note has been issued to.

totalAmount.description: Total amount of credit that has been applied to the customer's accounts receivable

totalDiscount.description: Any discounts applied to the credit note amount.

subTotal.description: Value of the credit note, including discounts and excluding tax.

additionalTaxAmount.description: Additional tax amount applied to credit note.

additionalTaxPercentage.description: Percentage rate of any additional tax applied to the credit note.

totalTaxAmount.description: Any tax applied to the credit note amount.

discountPercentage.description: Percentage rate (from 0 to 100) of discounts applied to the credit note.

remainingCredit.description: Unused balance of totalAmount originally raised.

status.description: Current state of the credit note.

issueDate.description: Date of the credit note as recorded in the accounting system.

allocatedOnDate.description: Date on which the credit note was fully allocated.

note.description: Any additional information about the credit note. Where possible, Codat links to a data field in the accounting software that is publicly available. This means that the contents of the note field are included when a credit note is emailed from the accounting software to the customer.

creditNoteStatus.title: Credit note status
creditNoteStatus.description: Current state of the credit note.

description.description: Friendly name of each line item. For example, the goods or service for which credit has been issued.

unitAmount.description: Unit price of the goods or service.

quantity.description: Number of units of the goods or service for which credit has been issued.

subTotal.description: Amount of credit associated with the line item, including discounts but excluding tax.

taxAmount.description: Amount of tax associated with the line item.

totalAmount.description: Total amount of the line item, including discounts and tax.

accountRef.description: Reference to the account to which the line item is linked.

discountPercentage.description: Percentage rate of any discount applied to the line item.

taxRateRef.description: Reference to the tax rate to which the line item is linked.

itemRef.description: Reference to the item the line is linked to.

trackingCategoryRefs.description: Reference to the tracking categories to which the line item is linked.

isDirectIncome.description: The credit note is a direct income if `True`.
